LanguageData.SS_LetterText:
{0} has lost a leg. What should help {PAWN_objective} get around again?

Prosthetic: a surgery is planned with the best leg you have or can make.
Crutches: cheap and quick, faster walking, but one hand is always busy.
Wheelchair: needs a smithy, works even without legs, at a calm pace.
LanguageData.SS_NoProsthetic: no leg prosthetic in stock or researched
LanguageData.SS_NoLegForCrutches: crutches need at least one leg
LanguageData.SS_NoBench: No bench can make {0} yet – build a crafting spot or a smithy.
LanguageData.SS_BillAdded: A bill for {0} was added at {1}.
LanguageData.SS_AidLeft: {0} doesn't need the {1} any more and left it.
